description: Fix an AI-generated PNG for use in a game: removes a fake transparent background (the grey and white checkerboard painted into the pixels) or a flat background colour, cleans the coloured fringe around edges, deletes stray specks and trims to the content. Also cleans the edges of images that already have real transparency. Runs on this computer and saves the results as files.

force.description: Remove the border colour even when no background was detected.

frame.description: trim to the content, keep the original size, or trim and pad to a square.

out_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: next to the input file.

pad.description: Transparent pixels to add around the result.

path.description: Full path of a PNG or JPG file on this computer. With a GameShipKit Pro key (GAMESHIPKIT_KEY) it can also be a folder, and every image in it is processed.

tolerance.description: How far a colour can be from the background and still be removed. Default 34 for a checkerboard, 40 for a solid colour.

name: fix_ai_png
title: Fix AI PNG background
